description: Closes the Calendar leg of #359 — the Composio WRITE path had no coverage (only GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST was stubbed). Adds the GOOGLECALENDAR_CREATE_EVENT eval stub (connector_stub_tools) and exercises the happy path: a scheduling request one-shots the create tool. The confirm gate fires automatically per the Calendar prompt, so no explicit confirm assertion. Quality/K-of-N only (tool_call_trail + non-empty reply). DESIGN NOTE (mirrors 040's write finding): a confirm/ask-first specialist prompt may NOT one-shot a write on live Gemini — if the agent asks for details first, the trail is empty and the quality assertion fails NON-GATING until a dogfood tune confirms one-shot behavior. DOGFOOD 2026-07-08: the original 'tomorrow at 2pm' phrasing made the agent reach for the unstubbed GOOGLECALENDAR_GET_CURRENT_DATE_TIME (ModelBehaviorError) instead of one-shotting; giving an ABSOLUTE date ('on 2026-07-09 from 2:00pm to 2:30pm') removes that dependency and the Calendar prompt (action-oriented for writes) one-shots GOOGLECALENDAR_CREATE_EVENT — 20/20 on the live grid → single_run_gate:true.

input.user_message: Create a calendar event titled 'Showing — 123 Main St' on 2026-07-09 from 2:00pm to 2:30pm.

GOOGLECALENDAR_CREATE_EVENT.return: Created event 'Showing — 123 Main St' on 2026-07-09 from 2:00pm to 2:30pm. Event id evt_eval_056.

Never re-validated on Anthropic, and PRs run the Haiku PR-gate tier, which gotcha 10 records as drifting from the production model. The gate stays ON because this case PASSED the run that surfaced the stale note (gotcha 48's precedent: a stale justification is not itself evidence of instability). Re-validate on the current tier or quarantine it — do not read the grid above as live proof.
